gloss: to be done cooking; to finish cooking (rice)

definitions.gloss: to be done cooking; to finish cooking (rice)
definitions.explanation: Said of rice or other grains when they have finished cooking and are ready to eat. An intransitive verb — the rice itself finishes cooking.

examples.japanese: ご{飯|はん}が{炊|た}き{上|あ}がった。
{炊|た}き{上|あ}がったら{十分|じゅっぷん}{蒸|む}らしてください。
examples.english: Once the rice finishes cooking, let it steam for ten minutes.

examples.japanese: {炊|た}きたてのご{飯|はん}が{炊|た}き{上|あ}がる{匂|にお}いが{台所|だいどころ}に{広|ひろ}がった。
examples.english: The smell of freshly cooked rice spread through the kitchen.

notes:
Specifically used for rice and grains. The subject is always the food itself, not the person cooking.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ご{飯|はん}が{炊|た}き{上|あ}がる: the rice finishes cooking
- ふっくら{炊|た}き{上|あ}がる: to cook up fluffy
- おいしく{炊|た}き{上|あ}がる: to finish cooking deliciously
- {炊|た}き{上|あ}がり: the finished state of cooked rice (noun form)

TRANSITIVITY:
Intransitive. The transitive counterpart is {炊|た}き{上|あ}げる (to finish cooking something). {炊|た}き{上|あ}がる describes the rice completing the cooking process on its own.

RELATED WORDS:
- {炊|た}く: to cook (rice) — the base verb
- {炊飯|すいはん}: rice cooking
- {炊飯器|すいはんき}: rice cooker
- {蒸|む}らす: to let steam (an important step after rice finishes cooking)
